# Trace

Stock `mes.trace.*` (plus `mes.production.mesEquipmentManager`) screens for Track & Trace genealogy. Work through them in this order:

1. **Equipment Manager** (Production module) - build the equipment model operations and material will be traced against.
2. **Operation Patterns** - record a trace operation against each of the 6 material flow patterns (Receive, Inspection, Split, Blend, Rework, Scrap) - every tab pairs a couple of screen inputs with a `system.mes.trace.configureMaterial`/`recordOperation` call in the `Trace.OperationPatterns` script library. See Sepasoft's own [Operation Pattern Framework](https://docs.sepasoft.com/articles/user-manual/operation-pattern-framework) doc for a fuller description of each pattern.
3. **Inventory** - filter by Material and/or Equipment and click Refresh to pull current on-hand lot quantities (via `system.mes.trace.getInventory`) into a table.
4. **Trace Graph** - visualize the genealogy recorded above, forward and backward from a selected lot.
